digest.headline: Rosa Vidal and Ana Perić talked at the harbor inn. Rosa Vidal: “Have you heard anything about the price of bread?” Ana Perić: “Only what everyone has. Nobody asked me.” Rosa Vidal: “Come by the market later. I will tell you the rest.”

items.text: Rosa Vidal arrived on the ferry.
Rosa Vidal was taken on as dock hand.

Rosa Vidal and Petar Ilić talked at the harbor. Rosa Vidal: “Have you heard anything about the price of bread?” Petar Ilić: “Only what everyone has. It will not end well.” Rosa Vidal: “Come by the tavern later. I will tell you the rest.”
